title: give the UI pass a ready render harness for TUI panes so each role does not write its own overlay test

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-015357-ca10, project ork, item S251:

give the UI pass a ready render harness for TUI panes so each role does not write its own overlay test

Evidence: I wrote render_overlay_test.go and overlay.json by hand, as the AGENTS.md UI-pass recipe says, to render 6 views at 5 sizes
